layout.arrangement: White slide with a thin red rectangular frame outline (x≈6%-94%, y≈8%-95%). Centered title at top ('Neural Network Model', red bold) with a centered blue bold subtitle directly beneath it. A yellow rounded slide-number badge ('2') sits in the top-right corner. Below the subtitle, a magenta/pink 'Input Sample' box at far left and a magenta/pink 'Target Label' box at far right are joined by a horizontal magenta dashed line with arrowheads at both ends. The dominant element is a large light warm-gray/beige rectangular panel (x≈7%-82%, y≈31%-83%) containing a fully-connected feed-forward neural-network diagram: magenta input-dot column at far left, 3 white input nodes, gray ellipsis dots, 3 blue hidden nodes (Net_i / O_i), 3 green hidden nodes (Net_j / O_j), 3 orange hidden nodes (Net_k / O_k), gray ellipsis dots, 3 white output nodes, and small white 'Output 1 / Output 2 / Output m' boxes at the right edge of the panel reached by red arrowheads. Magenta bias circles marked '1' sit below the blue and green layers, with a '1 Node Bias' legend at the panel's bottom-left. To the right of the panel is a tall dark-red vertical bar with rotated white 'Error Error Error' text, and further right three light-green 'Class 1 / Class 2 / Class m' boxes aligned with the three output rows. Below the panel, three callout boxes ('Previous Layer (Layer i)' blue, 'Current Layer (You are here)' green, 'Next Layer (Layer k)' orange) each have a matching upward block arrow pointing into the diagram. A solid black horizontal band runs along the very bottom edge of the frame.

layout.hierarchy: The large red bold title dominates, followed by the blue bold subtitle. The beige network panel is the largest visual mass and draws the eye through its colored layer columns (blue → green → orange) and pink connection web. The saturated magenta input/target boxes and dashed arrow form a secondary horizontal accent, while the dark-red 'Error Error Error' bar and green 'Class' boxes form a strong right-hand vertical accent. Small red node labels (Net_i, O_i, etc.) and blue italic weight labels (w_ji, w_kj) are tertiary detail; the bottom callout boxes are small but color-coded to match their layers.

visual_elements.description: Fully-connected feed-forward neural network inside a light warm-gray/beige rectangle (x≈60-740 px, y≈150-405 px) with a thin gray border. Thin pink/red lines connect every node to every node in the next column, with small filled red dots at node edges. Far left: a vertical column of magenta dots (one larger filled dot at y≈230, then three progressively smaller dots at y≈250, 270, 290) indicating omitted input nodes. Input layer: 3 white circles with thin black outlines at x≈150, y≈192 / 258 / 330, each containing a black 'Σ' on the left and a small black sigmoid S-curve on the right. After each input node, a horizontal row of 3 small light-gray filled circles (ellipsis) at x≈185, 197, 209. Hidden layer 1 (blue): 3 circles at x≈243 with light-blue fill and blue outline, each containing 'Σ' plus S-curve; red bold 'O_i' above each node (y≈180, 245, 315); red bold 'Net_i' above the top node (y≈160). Between blue and green columns: 4 blue bold-italic weight labels 'w_ji' — one horizontal above the top connection (x≈315, y≈182) and three rotated along diagonal connections (x≈310, y≈210 / 240 / 270). Hidden layer 2 (green): 3 circles at x≈400 with light-green fill and green outline, each containing 'Σ' plus S-curve; red bold 'O_j' above each; red bold 'Net_j' above the top node. Between green and orange columns: 4 blue bold-italic labels 'w_kj' (horizontal at x≈470, y≈182; three rotated at x≈465, y≈210 / 240 / 270). Hidden layer 3 (orange): 3 circles at x≈550 with light-orange fill and orange outline, each containing 'Σ' plus S-curve; red bold 'O_k' above each; red bold 'Net_k' above the top node. A small rotated blue label, best guess 'w_lk', sits on a diagonal connection near x≈505, y≈215. Between orange and output columns: 3 small light-gray ellipsis circles at x≈580, 592, 604. Output layer: 3 white circles with black outlines at x≈630, each containing 'Σ' plus S-curve. Small red right-pointing arrowheads at x≈670 lead into three small white boxes with black borders: 'Output 1' (y≈192), 'Output 2' (y≈258), 'Output m' (y≈330). Bias nodes: magenta filled circles with white '1' at (245, 373) and (400, 373), joined by pink lines to the layers above; legend at panel bottom-left: magenta circle with white '1' at (75, 396) followed by magenta bold-italic text 'Node Bias'.

Horizontal magenta dashed line at y≈127 running from the 'Input Sample' box (x≈118) to the 'Target Label' box (x≈772), with a magenta arrowhead pointing left at the Input end and a magenta arrowhead pointing right at the Target end. The 'Input Sample' box is a pink/magenta filled rectangle with magenta border and black bold two-line text 'Input' / 'Sample'; the 'Target Label' box is identical in style with black bold two-line text 'Target' / 'Label'.

Magenta filled dot column at the far left of the network panel acting as an ellipsis for additional input nodes (1 larger dot + 3 progressively smaller dots).

Small light-gray filled circles used as horizontal ellipsis markers between the input and blue layers (3 per row × 3 rows = 9 dots) and between the orange and output layers (3 per row × 3 rows = 9 dots).

typography_notes: Title is a large bold sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like) in red (#C00000), roughly 24 pt; subtitle is a slightly smaller bold sans-serif in blue (#0000CC), roughly 20 pt, with parentheses included. The 'Net_i', 'Net_j', 'Net_k' and 'O_i', 'O_j', 'O_k' labels are red bold serif (Times New Roman-like) with subscripted index letters. Weight labels 'w_ji' and 'w_kj' are blue (#0000FF) bold italic serif with subscripts. 'Node Bias' is magenta bold italic sans-serif. The 'Input Sample' / 'Target Label' box text is small black bold sans-serif on two lines. Bottom callout box text is small sans-serif (blue, green, orange respectively) on two lines. 'Error Error Error' is white bold sans-serif rotated 90°. 'Class 1 / Class 2 / Class m' and 'Output 1 / Output 2 / Output m' are small black sans-serif. No bullet lists are used anywhere on the slide.
animation_state: Nothing appears mid-build; all diagram elements, labels, arrows, the error bar and the class boxes are fully visible simultaneously. The only build-state cue is the yellow '2' slide-number badge in the top-right corner.
